entities.summary:
The Battle of Forbie was a pivotal clash between Crusader and Ayyubid forces on October 24, 1244, in the small village of Hiribya. 

 This medieval conflict marked a turning point in the Fifth Crusade, as the Crusaders' defeat led to the eventual withdrawal of their forces from the Holy Land. 

 The Battle of Forbie significantly weakened the Crusader presence in the region, paving the way for the Mamluk Sultanate's eventual conquest of the Levant. 

 The direct consequence of this battle was the loss of Jerusalem in 1244, marking the end of Crusader rule in the city.
